completed_not_to_repeat.decision: Close the six-site solver concern; no automatic refit or replay.

gate_policy.plan_review: Actual independent static design review is recorded separately; not execution approval.
gate_policy.launch: Every physical experiment needs a concrete enumerated run manifest, bound code/model/input hashes, independent review/recheck, finite ACTIVE scope and prelaunch identity verification.
gate_policy.source_count: Count original independent image clusters; seeds, frames, rows and timing repeats are nested.
gate_policy.reuse: Reuse only equal conditioning/noise/model/numeric/attention/capture identities; preserve original receipts.
gate_policy.parallel: L1,N1,B1,B2 may share a bank and run independently; D1 is a separate explanation line; A0 proceeds in parallel. Shared resource caps still apply.
gate_policy.resource: No live GPU entitlement is implied; recheck applicable session and per-scope limits.
gate_policy.failures: Record FAILED/INCONCLUSIVE/BLOCKED and exact missing assets; no implicit retries or transfer of old budgets.

entries.question: Bind real image-prompt sources and identities
entries.procedure: Bind CAL96/DEV48/CONFIRM96 slots to real disjoint image clusters; archive input/exposure checks. Read fixed-panel producer source and source-level random-order contract. Scope-specific CPU acquisition remains separately reviewed.

entries.question: Establish one compatible strong Attention background
entries.trigger: Parallel with capture and offline studies
entries.procedure: First static code/recipe audit, then separately reviewed two-source native/Attention compatibility pilot; actual algorithm/commit/backend/parameters and cache semantics must be bound. Unknown remains blocked; do not choose a name without implementation evidence.

entries.question: Start semantically balanced shared capture
entries.trigger: Real first-wave inputs and producer contract bound
entries.procedure: Capture all160 calls with 2048 matched random-order U/Y rows plus separate336 tubelet. First2 are pilot. Full-M proxy summaries/masks at6 sites; CAL12+DEV12 retain full-M U audit examples. Record partial completion before expanding.

entries.question: Expand to CAL48 and DEV48
entries.procedure: Continue identical producer; never recapture successful same-identity trajectories just to rebuild another method bank.

entries.question: Complete CAL96 and two-seed DEV48
entries.procedure: Complete planned sample coverage; default plan is CAL96/DEV48, not stop at12 after an interesting result.

entries.question: Separate harmful direction from overshoot
entries.trigger: Saved tested matrices and old inputs readable
entries.procedure: Use actual tested BF16 matrix predictions; compute gated e,c,a,b and exact F64 output-interpolation risk. No assumption that stable mathematical D was saved. No re-solving R1b; per-source optimal eta is diagnostic only.

entries.question: Separate source breadth, row density and regularization

budget.alternate_orders: Only C12/C48 fixed-total-row main-lambda contrasts initially; full C96 reused

entries.trigger: May analyze completed waves; full decision waits for C3
entries.procedure: Eight unique source/rows settings per roadmap, historical fixed prior and same-CAL Q1 tables separate. Current-CAL priors rebuilt in each fold. Expand exact finite fit list before scope approval. Stream/reuse F64 sufficient statistics without changing objective.

entries.question: Test nonlinear representation and added endpoint information
entries.trigger: In parallel with L1 on the same bank; not blocked on a positive linear finding
entries.procedure: Compare nested linear vs endpoint-tanh vs delta-linear+delta-tanh, shared fold-specific P/Q and feature scales, CAL-only regularization. Gate uses source CI upper<-2%; final result on DEV48x2 and both experts. A particular failure is not a universal linearity theorem.

entries.question: Locate ICC two-stage limitations
entries.procedure: Complete native/surrogate first x native/surrogate second factorial, retain cross terms and BF16 rounding. SVD/CD-SVD equal-rank comparison; conditional SVD-first/CD-second hybrid; rank redistribution only if actual repair predicts value.

entries.question: Separate Chipmunk proxy quality and sparse-update capacity
entries.trigger: True voxel/block means, valid-tail and author mask are verified
entries.procedure: Author faithful arm, equal-K frozen random/static, separately labelled global-P64 and bounded posthoc repair retaining original mask. No scattered-row means, no global-optimum label for repair.

entries.question: Disentangle Wan weights, state and interval
entries.trigger: Independent explanation branch; D4 matches and O checkpoint/scheduler available
entries.procedure: Reuse D4 trajectories; capture O40 conditional pre-W1 states. Same24 CAL mixed O-long/D budget per W and separate equal-budget adapted table. Shared D hit Gref, Oshort/half/long, common time/expert support and method-minus-Q1 contrasts.

entries.question: Build and verify one all80 candidate
entries.trigger: At least one legal family satisfies its source-level screen and matched linear/strong-baseline requirement; other mechanism branches remain parallel, not mandatory positive results.
entries.procedure: Freeze recipe before all80 building. Audit actual BF16 arrays and total online cost. Six-site success alone cannot authorize full-depth quality claims.

entries.question: Measure the candidate on its own free trajectories
entries.trigger: First12 semantically balanced DEV sources; complete source list frozen
entries.procedure: Dense native background is reusable; background changes require matched new targets. Q1 and N actual full160 free runs, typed neutrality, sourcewise full metrics. Later all48x2 Q1/N extend existing same-identity set; N-native is separate from system N+A.

entries.question: Test actual candidate direction and propagation
entries.trigger: Before posthoc terminal selection; freeze two cases/sites
entries.procedure: Common Q1 parent history/U/residual and correctly built candidate shadow cache. Rebuild later anchors after intervention. Record remaining-block work, terminal 2<r,q>+||q||^2 and joint nonadditivity; observed displacement alone is not improvement.

entries.question: Test candidate-state calibration once
entries.trigger: Local gain lost on N free trajectory
entries.procedure: Capture N own CAL state, not only Q1 state, match Dense CAL24 rows/target/training budget. Never fit on DEV. A changed candidate returns to T0/T2 with a new identity; no unlimited iteration.

entries.question: Resolve cumulative/expert interaction
entries.trigger: Single-site effect small but full-candidate difference remains decision-changing
entries.procedure: Reuse matched Dense and both; add high-only/low-only. No automatic40-layer intervention sweep.

entries.question: Freeze strong system baselines and one candidate
entries.trigger: FirstDEV12 then48; seven implementations and fields available
entries.procedure: D,Q,A,QA,NA,ICCA,ChipA. Reuse equal-identity first-repeat videos; captured Dense with observers cannot replace probe-free timing. Choose SPEED or QUALITY contract and freeze all metrics, margins and N before confirmation.

entries.question: One-shot source-disjoint final confirmation
entries.trigger: All sources truly unseen for model outputs/selection; N chosen once using DEV
entries.procedure: Full seven-arm source-paired comparison, all required quality guards, multiplicity-aware nearest-neighbor claims. Any boundary-crossing interval/required missing metric is INCONCLUSIVE. No effect-driven sample top-up or recipe change on this confirmation set.
entries.preexec_review_gate: A concrete approved pre-execution review bound in ACTIVE; REVIEW_CHAIN is a post-result audit index, not an input prerequisite.

budget_accounting.never_sum_blindly: Some quality conditions are first timed repetitions or reused from earlier stages; code must deduplicate on full identity. Auxiliary native-N, state calibration, high/low, compatibility and suffix scopes have separate explicit ceilings. No experiment is launched by this plan.
